title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer thresholds and stabilize regional failover backoff
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Over the last 48 hours we observed increased cascading regional failovers when the SLO enforcer entered an aggressive backoff mode. Root cause analysis showed two issues: (1) the circuit-breaker threshold math used a stale per-region load estimate causing early tripping under transient spikes, and (2) the backoff schedule applied at the global level instead of per-region which amplified failover churn across regions. This PR tightens threshold boundaries, fixes per-region backoff application, and adds a short-term damping throttle to prevent rapid re-trips during recovery windows.

What this changes: - Fix race in RegionSLOEnforcer that read stale LoadWindow values (off-by-one sampling index). - Compute circuit-breaker thresholds using the 95th percentile observed latency and a conservative margin (previously used mean + 2*stddev). - Apply exponential backoff state per-region (previously a single global token). - Add a 10s minimum quiesce window after a failover before allowing route reattach. - Add metrics: slo_enforcer.backoff_applied{region}, slo_enforcer.trips{region}, slo_enforcer.quiesce_seconds. - Unit + integration tests to cover region failover ordering and backoff decay.

Risk/rollback: This is a hotfix intended to reduce cross-region thrashing. Changes are additive and guarded by config flags (slo_enforcer.per_region_backoff=true by default after rollout). Rollback is trivial by reverting the hotfix or toggling the flag.

Testing and validation: - Local unit tests + redwood-integ stable suite run. - Canary rollout to us-west-2 with synthetic load for 2 hours; observed reduction in multi-region failover events from ~6/hr to 0-1/hr and 15% lower tail latency during recovery. - CI initially surfaced a flaky test (TestRegionEnforcerStable) which was fixed by adding a deterministic wait interval and a mock time advance in the test harness.

Notes: This PR is targeted as an urgent stability fix; follow-up work planned to document thresholds and add a runtime UI toggle in Console for SREs (ENG-4262).
